layout: Nine AI-action groups occupy 100-ID blocks; 11 defined slots per group are spaced nine IDs apart. Human context is a separate draft catalog in IDs 900-999.

categories.label: Brainstorming
categories.description: AI suggested ideas or directions during development of this work.

categories.label: Search assistance
categories.description: AI proposed search queries or helped locate possible source material.

categories.label: Source summaries
categories.description: AI summarized source material for the creator's use.

categories.label: Research synthesis
categories.description: AI combined information from multiple sources into working notes or findings.

categories.label: Requirements
categories.description: AI helped formulate requirements, constraints, or acceptance criteria.

categories.label: Outlining
categories.description: AI proposed an outline or structure for the work.

categories.label: Planning
categories.description: AI helped organize tasks, milestones, or a production plan.

categories.label: Concept exploration
categories.description: AI produced concepts or prototypes to explore possible approaches.

categories.label: Critique
categories.description: AI evaluated a draft or proposal and suggested improvements.

categories.label: Option comparison
categories.description: AI helped compare alternatives; this alone does not imply it made the final choice.

categories.label: Learning assistance
categories.description: AI explained concepts or techniques that informed the creator's work.

categories.label: Spelling and grammar
categories.description: An AI-based proofreading feature suggested spelling, punctuation, or grammar changes.

categories.label: Clarity editing
categories.description: AI helped clarify or simplify existing text.

categories.label: Style and tone
categories.description: AI helped change the style, tone, or voice of existing text.

categories.label: Rephrasing
categories.description: AI rewrote passages while preserving the creator's intended meaning.

categories.label: Translation
categories.description: AI translated content between languages.

categories.label: Text summaries
categories.description: AI generated a summary included in the delivered work.

categories.label: Headlines and labels
categories.description: AI generated titles, headings, captions, labels, or short interface text.

categories.label: Draft passages
categories.description: AI generated passages incorporated into the work.

categories.label: Full first draft
categories.description: AI generated a complete initial draft of the written work.

categories.label: Structured text
categories.description: AI generated tables, outlines, lists, templates, or structured written content.

categories.label: Text completion
categories.description: AI suggested sentence or paragraph completions incorporated into the work.

categories.label: AI selection and masking
categories.description: AI identified image regions, objects, or subjects for selection or masking.

categories.label: Background removal
categories.description: AI isolated a subject or removed an image background.

categories.label: Object removal
categories.description: AI removed selected objects and reconstructed the affected image area.

categories.label: Generative fill
categories.description: AI generated or replaced content inside an existing image or artwork.

categories.label: Outpainting and expansion
categories.description: AI generated content beyond an image's or artwork's original bounds, such as Generative Expand.

categories.label: Image enhancement
categories.description: AI denoised, sharpened, restored, or upscaled imagery; reconstructed detail may be inferred.

categories.label: Color and lighting
categories.description: AI generated or materially altered color, recoloring, lighting, or tonal treatment.

categories.label: Generated imagery
categories.description: AI generated a new image used in the work.

categories.label: Generated vector artwork
categories.description: AI generated vector shapes, illustrations, icons, or pattern artwork used in the work.

categories.label: Visual transformation
categories.description: AI transformed an existing image's style, composition, or visual appearance.

categories.label: Layout assistance
categories.description: AI proposed or generated visual arrangements, layouts, or design variants.

categories.label: Video selection and masking
categories.description: AI tracked subjects or produced masks for video editing.

categories.label: Video cleanup
categories.description: AI removed unwanted video content or reconstructed affected regions.

categories.label: Video enhancement
categories.description: AI denoised, restored, upscaled, or interpolated video frames.

categories.label: Generated video
categories.description: AI generated video footage used in the work.

categories.label: Video extension
categories.description: AI generated additional frames before, after, or beyond existing footage.

categories.label: Video transformation
categories.description: AI materially changed existing footage or its visual style.

categories.label: AI-assisted editing
categories.description: AI selected shots, assembled sequences, or proposed video edits.

categories.label: Animation assistance
categories.description: AI generated or modified animation, motion, poses, or keyframes.

categories.label: Generated 3D assets
categories.description: AI generated or reconstructed 3D meshes, scenes, or spatial assets.

categories.label: Textures and materials
categories.description: AI generated textures or materials applied to visual or 3D assets.

categories.label: Synthetic presenter
categories.description: AI generated or animated an on-screen presenter, avatar, or face performance.

categories.label: Transcription
categories.description: AI converted recorded speech into text used in the work.

categories.label: Captions and timing
categories.description: AI generated captions, subtitle timing, or alignment to audio.

categories.label: Audio cleanup
categories.description: AI reduced noise, removed unwanted sounds, or restored audio.

categories.label: Audio separation
categories.description: AI separated voices, instruments, or other sound sources.

categories.label: Audio editing
categories.description: AI selected, trimmed, arranged, or adjusted recorded audio.

categories.label: Synthetic speech
categories.description: AI generated spoken audio from text using a synthetic voice.

categories.label: Voice imitation
categories.description: AI generated speech imitating or derived from a particular person's voice; this label does not assert consent.

categories.label: Speech translation and dubbing
categories.description: AI translated spoken content or generated a replacement language track.

categories.label: Generated music
categories.description: AI generated music incorporated into the work.

categories.label: Generated sound effects
categories.description: AI generated sound effects or ambient audio incorporated into the work.

categories.label: Mixing and mastering
categories.description: AI assisted with equalization, dynamics, balancing, mixing, or mastering.

categories.label: Code completion
categories.description: AI suggested code completions accepted into the work.

categories.label: Generated functions
categories.description: AI generated discrete functions, components, or code snippets used in the work.

categories.label: Application scaffolding
categories.description: AI generated project structure, boilerplate, or an initial application implementation.

categories.label: Code translation
categories.description: AI translated or migrated code between languages, frameworks, or API versions.

categories.label: Refactoring
categories.description: AI reorganized or simplified existing code.

categories.label: Debugging
categories.description: AI investigated errors or proposed fixes used in the work.

categories.label: Test generation
categories.description: AI generated tests, fixtures, or test cases; this label does not assert that they were run or passed.

categories.label: Code review
categories.description: AI reviewed code and supplied findings or suggested changes.

categories.label: Documentation
categories.description: AI drafted or revised technical documentation or code comments.

categories.label: Configuration and infrastructure
categories.description: AI generated configuration, scripts, build definitions, or infrastructure descriptions.

categories.label: Architecture assistance
categories.description: AI proposed software architecture, interfaces, or data-model designs.

categories.label: Data extraction
categories.description: AI extracted structured information from documents or other unstructured inputs.

categories.label: Data classification
categories.description: AI classified, tagged, or labeled records or content.

categories.label: Data cleaning
categories.description: AI helped normalize, reconcile, deduplicate, or repair data.

categories.label: Synthetic data
categories.description: AI generated synthetic examples, records, or datasets used in the work.

categories.label: Query and formula generation
categories.description: AI generated queries, formulas, or analysis code.

categories.label: Exploratory analysis
categories.description: AI explored data or suggested patterns, relationships, or hypotheses.

categories.label: Statistical assistance
categories.description: AI helped choose, implement, or interpret statistical methods.

categories.label: Prediction and estimation
categories.description: An AI model produced predictions, estimates, or forecasts used in the work.

categories.label: Visualization assistance
categories.description: AI generated or helped design charts, diagrams, or data visualizations.

categories.label: Data interpretation
categories.description: AI drafted explanations or conclusions from data or analysis results.

categories.label: Model-based evaluation
categories.description: AI scored, ranked, or evaluated content or outputs against stated criteria.

categories.label: Suggested actions
categories.description: AI recommended actions that a human then performed.

categories.label: Single tool actions
categories.description: AI called tools to perform individual steps in the workflow.

categories.label: Multi-step execution
categories.description: An AI agent planned or executed a sequence of connected steps.

categories.label: Browser interaction
categories.description: An AI agent navigated or interacted with websites during production.

categories.label: File editing
categories.description: An AI agent created or modified project files.

categories.label: Command execution
categories.description: An AI agent ran commands, scripts, builds, or tests.

categories.label: External service actions
categories.description: An AI agent performed actions in an external application or service.

categories.label: Multiple agents
categories.description: Multiple AI agents contributed to the work or reviewed one another's output.

categories.label: Human approval gates
categories.description: Specified agent actions required human approval before execution.

categories.label: Unattended execution
categories.description: An AI agent performed some work without a human observing each step live.

categories.label: Iterative agent work
categories.description: An AI agent evaluated intermediate results and revised its work over multiple iterations.

categories.label: Question answering over supplied material
categories.description: AI answered questions using documents or other material supplied for this work.

categories.label: Meeting note synthesis
categories.description: AI produced a summary of a meeting or conversation for use in the work.

categories.label: Action item extraction
categories.description: AI identified follow-up tasks, owners, or deadlines from working material.

categories.label: Form field completion
categories.description: AI proposed or populated structured fields using information available in the workflow.

categories.label: Accessibility descriptions
categories.description: AI generated descriptions of visual or audio content to support accessibility.

categories.label: Reading-level adaptation
categories.description: AI adapted material for a stated reading level or comprehension need.

categories.label: Customer reply assistance
categories.description: AI drafted or proposed a response to a customer or audience member.

categories.label: Scheduling assistance
categories.description: AI proposed or arranged times, sequencing, or assignments for a workflow.

categories.label: Anomaly detection
categories.description: AI identified unusual patterns or records for further examination.

categories.label: Personalized recommendations
categories.description: AI selected or ranked suggestions for a particular user, audience, or context.

categories.label: Scenario simulation
categories.description: AI generated hypothetical outcomes or cases to explore decisions in the work.
